title: Kyoto AI Symposium — admin logbook and expense checklist
content:
Purpose: working notes for travel admin, vendor coordination, and expense capture for Kyoto AI Symposium (team booth + 1 talk).

High level plan:
- Travel window: 2026-03-22 (depart SFO) -> 2026-03-28 (return) — buffer day for unpacking and customs paperwork.
- Team on site: Maya (owner), Samir (booth lead), Ava (AV liaison) + one PM (TBD).
- Booth ship-to: Kyoto International Conference Center (KICC). Customs prefer invoice with HS codes. Ask shipping vendor for ATA carnet? (Q)

Pre-trip TODOs (top priority):
- Book taxis from KIX -> hotel -> KICC for arrival night (estimate JPY 10k). Use local taxi company contact: KyotoTaxi Co. +81-75-123-4567 (Samir to confirm rates).
- Confirm hotel rooming list and corporate rate with GreenLeaf Hotel Kyoto. Reservation ref: GL-RED-3421 (Ava). Check cutoff: 2026-03-08 for free cancel.
- Finalize booth crate contents and itemized invoice for customs. Shipping vendor: TransGlobal Expo Logistics (email: ops@transglobal-exp.com; account rep: Hiro Tanaka). Ask for tracking + customs codes.
- Submit expense pre-approval to Finance for estimated total > $5k (airfare + booth shipping). Use Concur form: EXP-TRAVEL-2026. Put 'events' tag.

Expense capture rules (Finance notes):
- Required receipts: airline e-ticket, hotel folio, taxi receipts OR per diem claim, DME/shipper invoice, AV vendor invoice, meals over JPY 3,000.
- Card vs corporate: use Redwood corporate card for booth ship and AV where possible; personal payment for taxis acceptable but must attach receipt and note currency conversion.
- Per diem for international days: follow Redwood policy (link in Confluence). If missing receipts for small items (<$10), add note and tag manager approval.
- Deadline: expenses submitted within 10 business days after trip end or reimbursement delayed.

Estimated budget (rough):
- Airfare (round-trip): $1,200 (economy flex)
- Hotel (6 nights, corporate rate): $1,050 (JPY conversion fluctuates)
- Booth shipping (crate + customs): $2,800 (estimate)
- AV (onsite screen + tech): $1,100 (deposit due 30 days prior)
- Local ground transport + meals: $700
Total est: $6,850 -> submit pre-approval for $7,500 cushion.

Onsite contacts & vendor notes:
- GreenLeaf Hotel Kyoto: events@greenleaf.jp, +81-75-987-6500, contact person: Ms. Yuko Sato. Ask for early check-in (12:30) and invoice to Redwood Inference (company tax ID: RED-12345).
- KICC Events Coordinator: Mr. Saito, events@kicc.jp, +81-75-555-1212 — booth setup windows: 03/23 08:00-12:00. Must have crate labels and contact number on crate.
- AV: Kyoto AV Solutions — proposal attached in Confluence page; point of contact: Kenji Morita, kenji@kyotoav.jp, +81-80-3344-2211. Confirm HDMI adapters and 110v power strip.
- Shipping: TransGlobal (Hiro Tanaka) — request commercial invoice with line items, HS codes, and values. Ask for projected customs duty and who pays (we prefer DDP if within budget).
- Meals / hospitality vendor: Omakase Catering (on-site receptions) — sample menu and dietary restrictions noted in Confluence. Contact: info@omakase-kt.com.

Booth / hardware checklist (pack photos to Drive folder):
- 1x 65" monitor + stand (shipped)
- 1x demo laptop (Maya) + power brick + spare battery pack
- 2x clickers, 8x name badges, cable organizers
- Printed one-pager (English + JP) x 300, sticker packs x 200
- Booth backdrop banner (rolled in crate) — attach AR tracking tag to crate
- AV adapter kit: USB-C -> HDMI, miniDP -> HDMI, power strips (US->JP plug adapters)

Day-of checklist (speaker + booth):
- Speaker (Maya) arrival at KICC 90 min before session; test demo on-site with AV (call Kenji 30 min prior).
- Booth: Samir to run 2-person shifts, use calendar to allocate 45 min demo slots. Use Slack channel #events-kyoto for immediate coordination.
- Payment: if AV requires day-of balance, use corporate card or get invoice for net-30. Keep receipt photo and email copy.

Reimbursement notes (practical):
- Capture receipts immediately in Expensify (or Concur) — photo, tag with "KYOTO2026" and name of traveler.
- Currency conversion: use day-of exchange rate or Concur auto-convert (Finance prefers bank rate). Add note if paid in cash.
- Split expense guidance: if FOOD or taxi was shared among team, submit one expense and add teammates under 'split' field with amounts.

Open questions / follow-ups (action owners):
- Q: Do we need ATA carnet for demo laptop and monitor? (Action: Samir -> check with TransGlobal and customs) — due 2026-02-20.
- Q: Can GreenLeaf provide invoice in English with company tax ID? (Action: Ava) — due 2026-02-18.
- Q: Confirm AV quote includes adapters and on-site tech support for 4 hours. (Action: Ava) — due 2026-02-25.
- Q: Who is the backup speaker if Maya's travel delayed? (Action: events lead) — due 2026-03-01.

Notes to self / messy bits (scratchpad):
- Bring physical adapters (I have 2 USB-C->HDMI from home). Label everything with our booth name to prevent losses.
- Pack receipts in an envelope labelled "KYOTO-REIMB" in carry-on + upload to expense system nightly.
- If shipping cost > estimate, escalate to Samir + finance and note reason in expense report.

Quick contact snippets (for wallet):
- GreenLeaf Hotel Kyoto reception: +81-75-987-6500
- KyotoTaxi Co. (pre-book): +81-75-123-4567
- KICC main line: +81-75-555-1212
- TransGlobal Expo Ops (Hiro): ops@transglobal-exp.com

Final reminders 48 hrs before departure:
- Confirm flight check-in and meal preference; upload boarding passes to expenses app.
- Confirm booth crate tracking and expected delivery window to KICC.
- Sync on Slack #events-kyoto: final schedule + emergency contact list.

Version notes: keep this doc as canonical day-of checklist; once trip is complete, move receipts and final actuals to 'events/expenses/kyoto-2026' folder and update Confluence summary page with final budget reconciliation.

-- end of logbook (working draft)
